items.title: Accenture (ACN) Expands Banking Role With UniCredit And IBM Partnership
items.summary: Accenture (NYSE:ACN) has agreed to a new collaboration with UniCredit and IBM to build a next generation banking platform in Europe. The arrangement includes Accenture acquiring a majority stake in a joint venture that will manage a large share of UniCredit’s technology infrastructure. IBM will work on modernizing UniCredit’s technology stack as part of this multi year initiative.
